QuestInfo.name: Tess's Confession
QuestInfo.2: Tess explains that his parents and Athena Pierce were close.\r\nTess requests that you keep his identity to yourself until he is ready to reveal himself.

0.0: The name's Tess. Athena Pierce and my parents, Destonen and Yuris, are old friends. \r\n#L0##bThat's great. Why do you keep calling me Kao?#l\n#k
0.1: Because you and Kao are practically identical. Are you sure you're not related?\r\n#L0##bI don't know anyone named Kao...#l\n#k
0.2: Fine, fine, you're not Kao, but the resemblance is uncanny...  \r\n#L0##bWhy were you chasing that bunny?#l\n#k
0.3: I wanted to question it. All I know is, he's #bpart of some shady organization#k. My current objective is to stop that group from... Well, that's none of your business. \r\n#L0##bNo, I want to hear more about the shady group!#l\n#k
0.4: Just know this: Something #bmajor#k is going to happen in Maple World soon. It's why I came back here. \r\n#L0##bOh! Athena Pierce wants to talk to you!#l\n#k
0.5: And I want to see her, but not yet. I have urgent business to take care of first. Speaking of which, I'd better get going.

yes.0: It's sweet that you chased me down for Athena Pierce. You really are like Kao...
yes.1: Anyway, gotta jet. I have a feeling our paths will cross again soon.

no.0: You want me to repeat all of that? Okay, again, from the very top...

1.0: I wonder if I should tell Kyrin I finished Athena Pierce's errand... Nah, I'm sure Athena Pierce already told her. But this Tess character...

yes.0: He said something big's going to happen soon. What does he mean?
